why_no_new_terms: An audit in the voice of an external scientific audit that verifies the Kohärenz-Protokoll and never doubts it. Its physics and mathematics (Landauer, Chaitin, the Monster group and Monstrous Moonshine, VOA orbifolds, dialetheism, Tarski, zero-knowledge proofs, the entanglement witness), its psychology (TSDP and its authors) and its narrative theory (Dramatica, the Story Mind, reader-response theory) are borrowed; its one name of its own making is the Protokoll's, reported — Landauer Heat Spike. The Mnemosyne-Archipel is a world named after a Guardian (J49), not the Guardian. No page is created from an audit's sources or mandates; the candidates the lookup found no page for stay candidates.

internal_tension: An audit that finds everything intact does not set two readings of one term against each other. Two things it says in one passage: AEGIS is destroyed by the heat of its own erasure and, after a total hardware overload, enters a state of Algorithmische Melancholie (L179); and the truth-rotation turns the moral reading round — AEGIS' order is the destructive vector, Kael's chaos and multiplicity the true coherence — which the audit verifies as its own claim (L83).
